activities.title: Charminar Exploration
activities.description: Visit Hyderabad's iconic Charminar, climb the minaret for city views, explore the surrounding Laad Bazaar. Entry is free; modest fee for camera use. Travel by auto‑rickshaw (≈ INR 150 round‑trip).

activities.title: Golconda Fort
activities.description: Take a short auto‑rickshaw ride to Golconda Fort. Explore the massive citadel, acoustic chambers and panoramic vistas. Entry fee INR 250 per person.

activities.title: Lunch at Shadab Restaurant
activities.description: Enjoy a traditional Hyderabadi thali (biryani, curries, raita, dessert) at Shadab near Charminar. Estimated cost INR 400 per person.

activities.title: Public Gardens (Bagh‑e‑Aam)
activities.description: Relax in the historic Public Gardens, stroll among old trees, fountains and the State Museum annex. Free entry; perfect for a light walk after lunch.

activities.title: Coffee & Snacks at Café Niloufer
activities.description: Wrap up the day with a cup of Irani chai and a small snack. Approx. INR 100 per person.
